steps.title: Brief
steps.text: You tell me the goal, the audience and the deadline. I ask the questions that shape the work.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: A clear scope, timeline and price before anything starts, so there are no surprises.

steps.title: Build or edit
steps.text: I make it and share progress as I go, with revisions built in.

steps.title: Launch & report
steps.text: It goes live, and you get the results or a clean handover, so you know it worked.

items.title: Music, Film & Brand Promotion
items.text: Your release, edited for short-form and posted on my channels, where my edits have reached 74M+ documented views.
benefits: Reach an audience that already watches edits like yours
An edit made for your release, ready to share on your own pages too
A results report with views, likes and shares, so you see what you got

items.title: Business Websites
items.text: A fast, modern website for your business, designed, built and launched for you.
benefits: Look credible on every phone, tablet and laptop
Customers can contact or book you straight from the site, and find you on Google
One person handles design, build, admin panel and launch, so nothing falls through the cracks

items.title: Video Editing
items.text: Short-form edits for creators, brands and businesses, built to hold attention.
benefits: Hooks, captions and music sync that keep people watching
Ready for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts
items.addon: Also available: AI product videos for e-commerce, made with Google Flow

note: The Services section: process (how I work, in order) and items (what I offer, in order of priority). service is the value the button preselects in the contact form (it must match a form option in 11-contact.json). benefits are written from the client's side: what they get by hiring me, not a feature list. Keep this section free of follower counts and screenshots; the numbers live in Track Record and Proof. No prices yet: add a price line when you decide.
